$comment: Terminal recordings behind the sample install. scripts/capture-demo-sessions.mjs runs every entry with scripts/capture-agent-scrollback.js against a scratch clone of the named repo, then the spawn and Command Terminal boots it derives from the dataset; re-run it when an agent TUI changes. Each entry maps to the session id the dataset replays it into. stopWhen cuts the recording on the first output matching the pattern; stopAfter cuts it at a time; cols and rows override the PTY size, which otherwise comes from geometry: every recording is made at the size of the surface it plays on, so a full-screen TUI reproduces and a row-based one wraps and pads where the desktop would. liveTailMs is how long before its recording's end the live frame opens a session shown as working (the rest streams in after the page opens; a session in demo-dataset.ts can carry its own liveTailMs); the capture script keeps the frame at that moment beside the recording's end (openFrame), and a still paints it for such a session.

geometry.$comment: Terminal sizes at the 1600x1000 site frame, read from the mock's sessions.__resizeCalls: a task window, a single Command Terminal window, and one of two tiled Command Terminal windows. A session records at the task window, a Command Terminal session at the single window, and a Command Terminal boot at both sizes its window can open at (terminal-<project>.json alone, terminal-<project>-tiled.json beside an existing terminal), chosen at spawn time. The rows depend on the session's agent: a Claude session's context bar carries the account's rate-limit pills and wraps to two rows, leaving 37; every other agent's bar is one row, leaving 39 (rowsByAgent). A replay cannot renegotiate the size the way a live PTY does.
